title: Hydrogen cyanide in three dimensions
hook: Turn a model of HCN and examine its shape.

knows: Atoms or cells can be represented with simplified models.
doesNotKnow: Around carbon, the C–H bond and the C≡N bond each count as one region of electron density, so the atoms are arranged linearly. The model shows connections, not bond order.

misconception: A familiar diagram automatically reveals the structure or function.
